title: Use motion data only for tangible user benefit

statement.en: Use motion data only when it provides a tangible benefit to people.
statement.ja: 利用者へ具体的なbenefitを提供する場合だけmotion dataを使う。

conditions: Tie motion-data use to a clear product or gameplay outcome.
exceptions: Fitness feedback and enhanced gameplay are examples, not required use cases.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Gyroscope and accelerometer experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるGyroscope and accelerometerの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Use motion data only when it provides a tangible benefit to people.” in the documented Gyroscope and accelerometer context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Use motion data only when it provides a tangible benefit to people.

apple_native_rule: Use motion data only when it provides a tangible benefit to people.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Avoid motion-data collection without user benefit

statement.en: Avoid collecting motion data without a tangible user benefit.
statement.ja: 具体的なuser benefitがないmotion data収集を避ける。

conditions: Don't gather motion data merely because it is available.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Gyroscope and accelerometer experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Avoid direct motion-based UI manipulation outside gameplay

statement.en: Outside active gameplay, avoid direct interface manipulation with accelerometers or gyroscopes.
statement.ja: active gameplay外ではaccelerometerやgyroscopeによる直接interface操作を避ける。

conditions: Motion gestures can be imprecise, physically challenging, and costly to battery life.
